Meghan Markle's Father Jailed Again After Tampering With Ankle Monitor

Thomas Markle, 82, was returned to jail in Florida after he removed his court-ordered electronic ankle monitor, violating the terms of his pre-trial release. He had been arrested and charged with possession of child sexual abuse material. His release was revoked following the ankle monitor incident. Separately, Meghan Markle made her first public appearance since her father's arrest, reportedly appearing emotional and "not strong enough" to deliver a speech with Prince Harry.
